Sumerians 1.0 is available now!

notes.title: Full Release Date & New Trailer
notes.notes:
[h3]NEW TRAILER[/h3]
[previewyoutube=qOvDBe2efwg;full][/previewyoutube]


I’m excited to announce the official release date of Sumerians: [b]October 17th[/b].

I want to express my gratitude to all the early supporters. Thanks to your help and feedback I have been able to continue the development of Sumerians until the entire roadmap has been completed.

During these 3 years of Early Access a lot of new content has been added to the game: the Palaces, Animal Husbandry, Fishing, the Health system, the Technology Tree, several new buildings, the entire campaign, and many more features. 

Thank you all of making it possible!

notes.title: Update 0.5.7
notes.notes:
Update 0.5.7 is live!

[b]French[/b] and [b]German[/b] localization have been added to the game!


[h3]Transporters and Orders Fixes[/h3]
The maximum load of transporters getting Beer as salary is now 150% percent. The normal loads for all transports are:
[list]
[*] Person: General: 4. Grain: 8, Bricks, Sandstone, Diorite, Mud and Clay: 2. Cedar Logs: 0
[*] Donkey: General: 20. Grain: 40, Bricks, Sandstone, Diorite, Mud and Clay: 10. Cedar Logs: 2
[*] Ox Cart: General: 50. Grain: 100, Bricks, Sandstone, Diorite, Mud and Clay: 25. Cedar Logs: 5
[/list]

The behavior of transporters when working on a Transport order has been revised, correcting some errors.
An updated behavour is that when transporters arrive at a building with more products that they can deliver, they will drop off as many as they can and then find another building to deliver the rest, except for transporters on a Transport order set to Full Load. In this case they'll remain until they have delivered all of their product. No more transporters are assigned to the same order if there is at least one transporter waiting, whether to load or to deliver, but those already on their way will join the wait. 

[b]Other Bugs and Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed: Place Type loading incorrectly.
[*] Breveries are now the last place to look when taking Grain for salaries instead of Ports. Now the order of consumption is: Storage buildings, Farming buildings, Ports, Breweries.
[*] Fixed: End condition in Transport orders loading incorrectly.
[/list]


[h3]Price Update Announcement[/h3]
A few days after this update, the price of the game will increase slightly. The price conversion for different currencies could also be updated following Steam's recommendations.
The game will be released outside of Early Access at a discounted price for a while. The release date will be announced in the coming weeks.

notes.title: Update 0.5.6
notes.notes:
Update 0.5.6 is live!

[h3]Game Difficulty[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36161197/4ef55f575f58528c0dabc721d89e5a9e7528139e.gif[/img]

The new difficulty system merges Fertility and Humidity into Soil and introduces Population difficulty.
[list]

[*] Soil: Crop yields, irrigation distance from canals and extraction speed for Clay, Mud and Salt.
[*] Population: How easily the needs of citizens are satisfied -private demands, services, taxes- to get new people who want to join the city.
[*] Trade:Better or worse trading prices
[*] Science: The amount generated from scribes, and how much is the workers limit raised after researching new technologies.
[/list]


Now every difficulty value can be edited before starting a new game.

A new Expert level (the most difficult) has been added, available when editing. 


[h3]Map selection[/h3]
Introducing a new large map size.

Added an option to move the map box to choose a different location.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36161197/6fc8cb36006928378f0e4574ec87348d46157187.gif[/img]


[b]Other changes[/b]

-The needs for a house or private workshop to upgrade would be shown on green or red in its panel, being easier to check which needs have been met.

-“Low” level of health is now “Medium”, so the 3 levels of heath are Medium, High and Very High.
Other minor bugs and corrections.


[b]Note of future updates[/b]
There will be few updates over the next few months as the game gets ready for its final release (date to be announced).
The official launch does not mean that the work on Sumerians will stop. Although every goal of the road map has already been achieved I hope to the able to keep adding more content in the future.
I just want to say how grateful I am to all of you for playing the game, and to those that have sent me feedback and new ideas. Thank you for making this possible!

notes.title: Update 0.5.5

Update 0.5.5 is live!

[h3]Transport orders[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36161197/0119b30c0246bcdfb82c14cc0beed3caf8386f4e.jpg[/img]

Now you can create orders to tell your transporters to move a product between two buildings.
There are several options when creating or editing an order:
[list]
[*] Select or change the product to be transfered.
[*] Tell the transporters to wait until their load is at full capacity
[*] Limit the maximum amount of transporters to work for this order.
[*] Choose between different order modes to activate it or end it:
[list]
[*] Always active.
[*] Transport a fixed amount of goods.
[*] Activate when the product in destiny is lower than a set amount.
[*] Activate when the product in the first buildng is higher than a set amount.
[*] Keep transporting until the building is empty of the product.
[/list][/list]
The orders are created in the Transporters buildings.
An order can be modified, paused or cancel at any time.
The orders will ignore any other limitations set on the building, such as having a reduced radius or the priorities set for the transporters.
When not working on an active order the transporters will keep working as normal.

[h3]Inventory bar[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36161197/27a7b1bd20bde0c4f78da98ba4a324a8b15408b2.jpg[/img]

A semi transparent “+” button on the top of the screen will activate the new inventory bar. Here you can select any product and see the amount available at your warehouses.

[h3]Livestock info[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36161197/96851e1c7db40f102d720c8bfc040afe90b82c0d.jpg[/img]

New info has been added in the Inventory and Workers panel to show how many animals you own. For donkeys and oxen you can also see how many of them are in an enclosure or working as transporters.

notes.title: New update: Epidemics
notes.notes:
Update 0.5.3 is live!

Epidemics are deadly diseases that spread among citizens. They originate from livestock farms and trading ports. After infecting one or more of its workers it will spread from their homes to neighboring houses. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36161197/b403ac5ac503685a12911bba673e6bbc27e96672.jpg[/img]

An epidemic can be contained using purification bonfires. The bonfires can be placed in housing zones that are already getting health effect from a Doctors’ building. There can be as many bonfires as doctors were in the city at the beginning of the epidemic. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36161197/9daf9fc28a65165a3807803cebf478fd117acc7d.jpg[/img]

After the epidemic ends you will have access to the total number of casualties.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36161197/a3470d8b833c7e1aed239b947f9a09f264e585f5.jpg[/img]


[b]Epidemics and the use of bonfires in ancient Mesopotamia[/b]

The idea of adding bonfires to the game comes from reading the article [i]Epidemics in the cradle of civilization[/i] by Troels Pank Arbøll:[url=https://sciencenordic.com/denmark-epidemic-history/epidemics-in-the-cradle-of-civilization/1758958]https://sciencenordic.com/denmark-epidemic-history/epidemics-in-the-cradle-of-civilization/1758958[/url].

The author mentions cases of rituals during epidemics in ancient Mesopotamia to prevent further deaths, “which culminated in the burning of a brush pile. Whether or not this incineration was an act of purification, or a means to handle large amounts of casualties, remains unknown.”

So, we may not know all the details about these rituals but we do know that they use fire, and that large pyres would have been burned at times during epidemics in ancient Mesopotamia.


Anyway, if you just want to get rid of all epidemics in your cities there is no need to perform purification rituals to appease the gods. They can be can be switched off from the Settings screen.

0.5.1 update is live!

[h3]Health system[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36161197/4dc0bd1468ec18c392e43232bf33ebc6b3346af5.png[/img]
The new Health service is provided from the Doctors’ building found in the Security & Health building menu section.

Health now replaces “Jobs” in Quality of life stats.

Health also becomes necessary for the citizens houses' to upgrade.


[h3]Sheep[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36161197/be243178a084b75e1b31b314c020174fd45a00e1.png[/img]
New breeding animal available.

Sheep produces Woolen Fleece twice a year, and when they reach their maximun age they are sacrificed to get some Hides and Meat.

New production chain: Sheep → Woolen Fleece → Wool → Dyed Wool

Wool and Dyed Wool are produced in the same buildings as Linen and Fabrics.

Workers salaries can be improved with Dyed Wool instead of Fabrics. This can be changed for each building on their own panel.


[b]Other balancing adjustments:[/b]
[list]
[*] Flax yield has been reduced.
[*] Hides production from cattle has been increased.
[*] More storage capacity in livestock farms.
[*] Salt extraction speed has been increased.
[/list]

[h3]Ox Carts[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36161197/1c8e20fc827e4c16c3f78005bfe77a16f9a71968.png[/img]
Ox Carts can tranport more goods that Donkeys.

Oxen can’t be brought or bred, and can only be acquired from existing Cattle when is moved to an Oxen enclosure.

Oxen carts are unlocked after researching ‘Wheeled vehicles’ in the Tech tree, a technology that becomes available after ‘Potter’s wheel’ has been discovered.

notes.title: Update 0.4: Livestock
notes.notes:
Update v.0.4.1 is live!


[h3]Introducing Cattle.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36161197/d736d4072bc45f4befd1f877abe8921c06771dab.png[/img]

[b]New Buildings:[/b]
- Livestock. An enclosure to breed and raise your cattle.
- Salt Pond.
- Meat Curing.

[b]New production chain:[/b]
Cattle provides Meat, which can be used with Salt to get Cured Meat.
Untreated Meat spoils quickly and it can’t be traded or stored in any other building.
Cured Meat can also be used to increase salaries in some buildings and it’s also needed to complete 'Hymns' in the Tech tree.

[b]New Technology: [/b]
Food Preservation. Unlocks Salt Pond and Meat Curing

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36161197/a3d4b94dae0b38a4239dbb2088ad5458bceab0ee.png[/img]

Other Changes:
A new artifact have been added to the Ziggurat that require Jewelry.
The Cedar logs artifact – wooden doors- has also been added to Temple.

Fixes:
An error in farming taxes. You may be getting more grain from taxes now.
UI elements will no longer close after dragging the camera with the mouse right button.

[b]Save game compatibility[/b]: All games from previous versions are still playable, but some changes in storage buildings to add new products will reset any saved configuration in these buildings to 'Accept all'.

[h3]What’s next[/h3]
Livestock features in the game will continue to expand in future updates:
[list]
[*] Leather production. Guards will require Leather goods to get higher security levels.
[*] Donkey and Sheep breeding.
[*] Wool production.
[*] Oxen carts for the transporters (and maybe bridges, so they can cross rivers).
[*] Health. The concentration of people and animals brought with it an increase in infectious diseases, so it may be time to add some doctors.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.3.5 is live!
notes.notes:
Update 0.3.5 is live!

[h3]Government buildings / Palaces[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36161197/d726db25dfbaafafc39a7a2adf868bb1f7036c75.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Three levels of government buildings.
[*] Modular construction by independent blocks to create different shapes.
[*] Choose the style of each block.
[*] Generate science points for the new Tech tree.
[/list]

[h3]Tech tree & Trade routes[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36161197/a1e1066fadf3e8854f3ecd02fbae621cfe41790b.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Progress by unlocking new technologies.
[*] The city will start with limited storage capacities and a maximum number of state workers, as well as buildings and trade routes that will have to be unlocked.
[*] Choose between 4 science speed modes before starting the game: Normal, faster, slower, or without tech tree with everything unlocked.
[*] Trade routes. A port can only operate one trade route at a time.
[*] More trade routes and products will be added in future updates.
[/list]

[h3]New Wall[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36161197/cef82ba86928107c0855ae6bb9a3d4cf1fc868a7.png[/img]
New size wall now necessary for the construction of the Ziggurat and the Royal Palaces, and for houses of the highest level to spawn.

[h3]Reputation → Religious influence[/h3]
[list]
[*] The reputation system for attracting new immigrants is being simplified to function only with religious influence.
[*] A new screen to show more clearly how much religious influence is being generated by the temples and if it’s enough for attracting new migrants.
[*] A new temple will be added to the game in a few weeks.
[/list]

[h3]Other changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Now temples can hire workers only with grain.
[*] Buildings that can store Grain as well as other products will show two bars with different storage capacities.
[*] The fish ratio has been changed to 1 Fish = 10 Grain and the amount of fish sold has been reduced accordingly.
[*] Huts will spawn if there are no available houses when immigrants arrive or if they have been waiting for a long time.
[*] Calculations for agents paths have been updated to reduce some lag and avoid drops in productivity especially in late game.
[/list]

[b]Note on saved games:[/b] Games from older versions are compatible and they will load as a sandbox play mode without tech tree.

notes.title: Update preview
notes.notes:
The new update is already available in the test branch:

Open Steam Library > Right click Sumerians > Select Properties > Go to tab 'Betas' at the top > Select 'testing' in the drop-down.

Note on Saved games: Games from older versions are compatible and they will load as the sandbox play mode without tech tree.

What’s included in version 0.3:

[h3]Government buildings / Palaces[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36161197/7a2c412c8c2c633324edc5af34058f35e4e8a025.png[/img]
There are three levels. They have a modular construction by independent blocks so you will be able to create different shapes. Once finished, the style/decoration can be changed.
The function of government buildings is to generate science points for the new Tech tree.


[h3]Tech tree[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36161197/a1e1066fadf3e8854f3ecd02fbae621cfe41790b.png[/img]
A new play mode in which the game progress by unlocking new technologies.
The option to play with everything unlocked is still available.
The city will start with limited storage capacities and a maximum number of state workers, as well as buildings and trade routes that will have to be unlocked.


[h3]Trade routes[/h3]
Each port can now only operate one trade route at a time. For example, to get Copper you will have to trade with the northern region of Mesopotamia, and to buy Tin with the area of the Zagros mountains (East of Sumer).


[h3]New Wall[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36161197/cef82ba86928107c0855ae6bb9a3d4cf1fc868a7.png[/img]
The new size of the wall is now necessary for the construction of the Ziggurat and the Royal Palaces, and for houses of the highest level to spawn.


[h3]Reputation → Religious influence[/h3]
The reputation system for attracting new immigrants is being simplified to function only with religious influence. A new screen show clearly how it is produced and if it’s attracting new migrants.

notes.title: Development Update. Management & Control
notes.notes:
To manage a big city and achieve prosperity you'll need various forms of supervision and control. In [b][i]Sumerians [/i][/b]there are several panels providing information about how the city grows, the needs of your citizens, the state of the inventory, and different elements to manage your workers and to adjust or give special orders to each of your buildings.
  
- The designs for the interface are still a work in progress and some elements may change before, or during the Early Access -

[h3]Basic Info[/h3]
In a fixed panel in the bottom left corner you’ll find, among other things, the total population, the total grain storaged by the state and the game speed buttons.

Some of these elements will open other panels at the bottom center of the screen:
[list]
[*] Population panel: population growth, population composition, job rate, and emigration values.
[*] Satisfaction and Reputation panel: Your reputation relative to the size of the city, the values that determines the quality of life and the state of the private business in the city. A high satisfaction will attract new immigrants and the reputation of the city will influences the amount of immigrants arriving.
[*] State Economy panel: All the products owned by you (the State), your workers, and a tool to modify the taxes.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36161197/89b4c2fe6eddf61ae7c92ee88e333f2601857c8c.png[/img]



[h3]More Stats[/h3]
[list]
[*] Population stats.
[*] Stats for your products with a sum of the total wealth of the inventory converted to grain value, and the incomes and expenses for each product (produced, bought, consumed, stolen, etc.…)
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36161197/aea8e3e310d081dbc360537195a2a10236cbe25e.png[/img]



[h3]Single Builing Panels[/h3]
After selecting one of your buildings you can change how many workers you want to hire, the quality of the salaries, adjust the radius or the priorities of some buildings and give orders to the storages or the trade buildings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36161197/08d87124475a00b20c5e90e04d6068b0aa28534c.png[/img]



[h3]Other Info Views[/h3]
[list]
[*] Signs over your buildings -that can be visible or hidden- to see which ones are paused, lack materials, their level of storage or the progression of constructions.
[*] And finally, you can also select some values to view over the terrain, like the land value, the security, the irrigation or the water access.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36161197/a9ea36fa4ebe6a2c23e76cb984ef3cf52644474d.png[/img]

notes.title: Development Update. Buildings.
notes.notes:
Hello. This is the first development update for Sumerians so first of all I want to thank you all that have wishlist or follow, and for all your messages of support.

Since the publishing of the Steam page I've been working mainly on the game interface and adding a few more buildings that were not ready when the first trailer was release.
I've also included the option to increase or reduce the number of people walking on the streets -going to the market or to their jobs-, so you can choose if you want to have busy streets or to reduce the number of agents in case you are having slow framerates.

The new models that have been added:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36161197/c7e807a454028d059adf14a14bc43ec0a9ab2e55.png[/img]

Top: Warehouse, Mud Temple, Guard Post.
Bottom: State workshops. Pottery, beer, fabrics, dyeing and metallurgy.


And here you can see the building menu while placing a building (Granary):

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36161197/f00f252283e912ba8d264a230810b9e777b8d2b3.png[/img]

The design of the interface is still a work in progress and some elements may be modified before or during the Early Access.


[h2]Buildings[/h2]
This is the final list of buildings.

Citizens buildings (zoning): Different models for houses, workshops, small fields and street markets.

State buildings that you can place and manage:

Agriculture: 
- Barley and Flax fields.
- Agriculture workers.

Construction:
- Builders
- Brick making.

Product management (moving, storage, trade):
- Transporters.
- General storage.
- Granary.
- Warehouse.
- Port.

Production:
-Mud Pit.
-Pottery.
-Beer.
-Linen fabrics.
-Fabrics dyeing.
-Metallurgy.

Temples:
- Mud Temple.
- Small Temple.
- Ziggurat.

- Guard Post.

Water: 
- Well.
- Shaduf.
- Irrigation canals.

Walls:
- Mud walls.
- Brick walls.

Decorations:
- Plants and gardens.
- Columns.
- Statues.

More buildings will be added during the Early Access like administration buildings and a bigger temple, and I'll be open to your suggestions for new models and more beautification elements for your cities.


You can also check on [url=https://twitter.com/SumeriansGame]twitter.com/SumeriansGame[/url] for more updates.
